names._readme: Nowflation v2.0 plan Section 1 and growth build v2 Section 4.2: the public display names AND the gauge config. Change a name or a qualifier here (one line) and every page, title, chart legend, card, email, narrative, exported image and share string that names the series follows on the next publish. The series ids and every internal key stay as they are. `realtime` and `cpi_gauge` are the display names other code has read since v2.0; `gauges` carries the fuller record and reuses those same strings.

realtime.qualifier: Real-time inflation measurement. Not a CPI forecast.

cpi_gauge.qualifier: Tracks official CPI. Forecasts are labeled.

realtime: Nowflation Realtime measures the prices being set in the US economy today. Where a live market price exists we use it. That means pump prices, vehicle auction and transaction prices, and rents on leases signed this month. Where no credible live source exists we hold the latest official reading and label it as held.
We don't tune this number to match CPI or any other index. CPI runs on inputs that are weeks to years old, so the gap between Realtime and CPI is the point of the series.
We judge Realtime on how much of the basket is live and how old its inputs are. We also check whether official CPI moves toward it over the following 5 to 12 months.
charter.cpi_gauge_title: What the Nowflation CPI Gauge measures
cpi_gauge: The CPI Gauge estimates what official CPI would read if its inputs were refreshed today. It keeps CPI's construction, including the slow way shelter moves as old leases roll over. It's the bridge between Realtime and the print, and it feeds our CPI forecast.

shelter_age_formula.reference_lag: as-of date − last day of the newest rent reference month in use
shelter_age_formula.formula: mean lease age = Σ_{k=0..K} k(1−p)^k ÷ Σ_{k=0..K} (1−p)^k months, × 365.25/12 days

definitions.live_share: sum of basket weights of components whose value today comes from a non-BLS market source that is not stale (older than 2× its expected cadence) and not older than the month its official subindex already holds
definitions.stale: a live component whose every source is older than 2× its expected cadence; it holds its official BLS subindex until a fresh observation arrives
definitions.stepped_aside: a monthly source inside its freshness window steps aside once the BLS has published a newer month; the component holds that newer official print and counts as held, not stale
definitions.avg_input_age_days: basket-weighted average of as-of date − observation date: daily inputs use the price date; monthly inputs and held BLS subindexes use the last day of the reference month; the CPI Gauge shelter adds the mean lease age implied by its tenure memory

components.label: Shelter: Rent
components.source: Zillow ZORI (all homes, SA) + Apartment List national rent (new leases)

components.label: Shelter: Owners' equivalent rent
components.source: Zillow ZORI (all homes, SA) + Apartment List national rent (new leases)

components.label: Motor fuel
components.source_note: the year-ago level (October 7, 2025) is EIA weekly retail regular gasoline for the week of September 29, 2025, chain-linked to AAA national average regular, whose history here begins July 2, 2026; the comparison is AAA national average regular on both sides from July 2, 2027

components.label: New vehicles
components.source_note: every live source is past its freshness window (twice its publishing cadence), so the official subindex is held until a fresh observation arrives

shelter.renewal_series: none found: no public renewal-rent series with monthly cadence and usable terms; Realtime shelter is new-lease only

parameters_md:
# Nowflation Realtime — parameter inventory (method v2.0; v2.1 and v2.2 rows marked)

Plan: Nowflation v2.0, Section 5.4. Every parameter the Realtime build uses, its value, and where the value came from. **None of these values was chosen, fit, calibrated or validated using official CPI error (same-month or any horizon), the scoreboard, print-eve error, or any third-party index including Truflation.** Each value is either a property of the source (its publication timing, its cadence), a rule written in the plan, or a structural choice stated in the charter. The build guard (`charterGuard.js`, check group `realtime_charter_guard`) fails the build if the Realtime code imports or calls scoreboard grading, print-eve error, the shelter calibration, the nowcast/ensemble, or Truflation functions.

Written 2026-09-15, before any lead test was run.

| Parameter | Value | Where it applies | Where the value came from |
|---|---|---|---|
| Components | 21 (v1.4 list, `engine.js COMPONENTS`) | whole basket | carried over from v1.4 unchanged (plan 5.1) |
| Weights | BLS CPI-U relative-importance tables by year (`weights.json`), December of the prior year governs each year | aggregation | BLS publication; carried over from v1.4 (plan 5.1) |
| Weight switch | chain-linked at December 31 | aggregation | v1.4 construction, carried over (plan 5.1) |
| Aggregation (v2.2) | each December relative importance multiplies the component's price relative since that December; years chain December to December (`engine.js blsChainAggregate`). D_c(Y), the December level: the December 31 value when a live source prices the component that day, otherwise its value once the December print is held (mid-January). v2.0 and v2.1 multiplied the relative importance by the component's level since January 2018 | headline level, YoY, MoM (live share and input age unchanged) | BLS: relative-importance ratios "are used as weights to combine relative changes in prices of the selected components over specified periods" (bls.gov/cpi/tables/relative-importance) and the CPI's modified Laspeyres with a December pivot month (BLS Handbook of Methods, CPI, "Calculation"). Found in the 2026-09-23 audit; a formula correction, not a fitted choice. As an arithmetic check only, rebuilding official CPI-U from the BLS subindexes alone with each formula (2020-2026): 0.142pp RMS against 0.165pp |
| Used vehicles, mid-month read (v2.2) | Manheim's mid-month index (`manheim_muvvi_midmonth`, from Cox's own RSS feed excerpt) enters on its publication date, 18 days after the 1st of its month, data as of the 15th; the full-month value (published ~7 days after month-end) follows and supersedes it. Month-keyed YoY compares the mid-month read with the full month 12 months earlier | used_vehicles | same index and publisher as the full month (Cox Automotive); publication timing observed (Mid-September 2026 posted 2026-09-18). v2.0/v2.1 wait for the full month |
| Shelter sources considered and declined (2026-09-23) | Redfin (median asking rent, new listings, 5+ unit buildings): published only as an interactive dashboard, no data file or API. Realtor.com (asking rents, 50 metros): press releases only; its public data files cover for-sale listings. Penn State/ACY Marginal Rent Index: apartment investors' net operating income inferred from sale prices times cap rates, not a rent tenants pay (it stays ingested) | shelter | measurement and licensing grounds, stated before any comparison was run |
| Base period | January 2018 = 100 | level | carried over (plan 5.1) |
| Held YoY basis | month-keyed: the held print's level vs the same subindex 12 months earlier; a live component whose sources are all stale uses the same official month-keyed change | held components and stale live components | carried over from v1.4 (plan 5.1); plan 5.3 fallback to hold |
| Live YoY basis | monthly sources (rents, used and new vehicles): month-keyed — each fresh active source's own change from its latest published reference month m to m−12, weighted by the blend weights; daily and weekly sources (fuel): the level vs the same calendar day 12 months earlier | live components | plan 5.1/5.2 (month-keyed year-ago bases). A calendar-day lookup was rejected: when a monthly file lands later than its typical lag it compares m with m−11 (seen on new vehicles on 2026-09-15: July 2026 vs August 2025) |
| October 2025 imputation | geometric mean of September and November for YoY/MoM bases only | held components | carried over from v1.4 (plan 5.1) |
| One-day glitch hold | a live move over 5% in a day holds one day at the prior value | live components | carried over from v1.4 (`QC_DAILY_MOVE` 0.05) |
| Staleness threshold | 2 × expected cadence: daily 2 days, weekly 14, monthly 62 (31-day month) | every live source | plan 5.3 rule |
| Expected cadence | AAA daily; EIA GASREGW weekly; Zillow ZORI, Zillow single-family ZORI, Apartment List, Manheim, KBB monthly | staleness | each publisher's release schedule |
| Publication lags | ZORI 16 days after month-end; Zillow single-family ZORI 16 (same file release as ZORI); Apartment List 2 days after month-end; Manheim 7 after month-end; KBB 12 after month-end; GASREGW 2 days; BLS subindexes on the BLS release calendar | publication-date stepping | observed release timing, v1.4 table (`PUBLICATION_LAG_DAYS`); the single-family ZORI uses ZORI's value because it ships in the same Zillow release |
| Shelter: Rent sources (public, configuration D) | Zillow ZORI (all homes plus multifamily, smoothed, SA) 0.5 + Apartment List national new-lease rent 0.5 | shelter_rent (full rent weight) | plan 5.2: "blend them equally unless one is stale"; renormalized to the fresh source when one is stale. Steven's decision D, 2026-09-15, before any Realtime reading was published. Measurement reason: transacted new-lease rents (Apartment List) net out concessions that asking rents (Zillow) do not (Zillow reported 39.2% of its rental listings offered a concession in August 2026). Not chosen by any fit |
| Blend definition | YoY: the weighted mean of each fresh source's own month-keyed YoY at its latest published reference month (on 2026-09-15: Zillow July 2026 vs July 2025 +2.3994%, Apartment List August 2026 vs August 2025 −0.7852%, mean +0.8071%); which month each source contributes is set by publication-date stepping. Level: a chain-linked blend of each fresh source's day-to-day relative change, spliced onto the official subindex. Year-ago base: level ÷ (1 + YoY) | both shelter lines | plan 5.1/5.2. A component's headline contribution is its BLS weight times its year-ago level relative to the basket (the Laspeyres share) times its YoY, so a contribution divided by the nominal weight is not the component's YoY (on 2026-09-15 under B, Shelter: Rent's share was 7.92% of the basket against a 7.84% weight) |
| Shelter configurations in shadow (not published) | A: Owned Zillow single-family (Zillow all homes when stale), Rent Zillow all homes · B: Owned Zillow single-family (the blend when stale), Rent the blend · C: Owned and Rent Zillow all homes | stored on every run in realtime_runs.shadow_configs next to the public D reading | comparison; C is the public configuration if Apartment List declines |
| Apartment List public switch | `realtime.shelter.apartment_list_public` = true (engine config table), set 2026-09-15 | true → configuration D; false → configuration C | Steven's decision on measurement grounds. Apartment List publishes its Rent Estimates for public use; if that changes, the switch goes to false and the public number moves to C (Zillow all homes on both shelter lines), logged on /corrections as a method change. No permission request is sent (Steven's decision, 2026-09-15). No Realtime reading had been published when D was chosen, so the public method is v2.0 |
| Shelter: Owned source (public, configuration D) | the same equal blend of Zillow ZORI all homes and Apartment List as Shelter: Rent | shelter_owned (full owners' equivalent rent weight) | Steven's decision D: pricing all of shelter on one index matches how the CPI Gauge prices shelter (its CPI-comparable headline prices the owners' weight on the all-tenant rent index). Apartment List publishes no single-family series, so the owners' weight uses a blend that leans toward apartment rents; Zillow single-family ZORI is tracked in shadow (configurations A and B) for comparison. Rental equivalence at market rents; not house prices or mortgage rates |
| Renewal rents | not used; shelter is new-lease only | shelter | plan 5.2: no public renewal-rent series with monthly cadence and usable terms was found (Apartment List publishes new leases only; RealPage's renewal figures are proprietary and its feed is stale, which the plan excludes; NMHC and Yardi Matrix data are not public). Stated on /methodology |
| Tenure memory (p, K), all-tenant index, CPI-scale map, house prices, mortgage rates | not used | — | plan 5.2 exclusions |
| Fuel sources | AAA national average regular, daily (tier 1); EIA weekly retail regular gasoline GASREGW (tier 2) | fuel | live market pump prices; EIA used when AAA is stale or before AAA history begins |
| Fuel held basis | BLS motor fuel subindex CUSR0000SETB (gasoline CUSR0000SETB01 if motor fuel is absent) | fuel when no live source is fresh | plan 5.3: held components hold the official BLS subindex (v1.4's fuel basis, GASREGW, is an EIA market price, so it is a live source here) |
| Used vehicles source | Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index, monthly | used_vehicles | plan 5.3 (already live in v1.4) |
| New vehicles source | Kelley Blue Book / Cox average transaction price, monthly | new_vehicles | plan 5.3 (live since 2026-09-04) |
| Held components | the latest official BLS subindex, exactly (no drift, no trailing pace, no nowcast) | the other 16 components | plan 5.3 |
| Live share | sum of basket weights of components whose value today comes from a non-stale non-BLS market source | freshness metric | plan 6.1 |
| Average input age | basket-weighted average of as-of date minus observation date (daily: the price date; monthly: the last day of the reference month; held: the last day of the latest reference month) | freshness metric | plan 6.2 |

## Sources and terms

- Zillow ZORI and single-family ZORI (downloaded from Zillow's published research CSV files): Zillow Terms of Use, https://www.zillow.com/z/corp/terms/ (page build dated 2026-07-08, read 2026-09-15), section 4.C Use of Content: "the aggregate level data provided on the Zillow Local-Info Pages (the “Aggregate Data”) may be used for non-personal uses, e.g., real estate market analysis. You may display and distribute derivative works of the Aggregate Data (e.g., within a graph), only so long as the Zillow Companies are cited as a source on every page where the Aggregate Data are displayed, including “Data Provided by Zillow Group.” Such citation may not include any of our logos without our prior written approval or imply any relationship between you and the Zillow Companies beyond that the Zillow Companies are the source of the Aggregate Data." Realtime is a derivative work of national aggregate rent data, so every page that shows a Realtime figure carries "Data Provided by Zillow Group" with no logo. The research data page (https://www.zillow.com/research/data/) no longer carries its own usage sentence, only a copyright line. The personal, non-commercial clause in the same Terms (section 23) covers MLS listing data only.
- Apartment List national rent estimate (https://www.apartmentlist.com/research/national-rent-data): public since 2026-09-15 by Steven's decision. Apartment List publishes its Rent Estimates for public use on its research data page. Nowflation shows Apartment List's national YoY rent growth and the blended shelter figure, cites Apartment List by name with a link to its National Rent Report, and does not redistribute the raw national file on /data, through any API path or in any embed. If that changes, Realtime moves to configuration C as a logged method change. Cited by name with a link to its National Rent Report on every page that shows the Realtime shelter sources.
- AAA, EIA, Manheim (Cox Automotive), Kelley Blue Book (Cox Automotive): already ingested for v1.4 under the same attribution.

lead_test.record_type_note: Realtime as published: a reconstruction under method v2.0 before its launch date (2026-09-15), the live readings from then on (method v2.0 through 2026-09-27, v2.2 from 2026-09-28); out of sample with respect to CPI (no parameter is fitted to CPI)

rule.pass: since-2019 window: at some k in 5..12, r(Realtime) − r(persistence) ≥ 0.03
rule.badge: "clears" when the pass rule holds; "ties" when the best difference is under 0.03 in absolute value; "trails" otherwise; both r values always shown
rule.months: calendar-month averages of daily readings, complete months only; the same months for every series within a window and k
rule.turning_point: the month the 6-month change in YoY flips sign and holds that sign for 3 months

lead_test.badge: Realtime clears CPI's own persistence: r 0.32 vs 0.23 at 12 months ahead, since 2019 (79 months)

shelter_config.label: Owned and Rent = equal blend of Zillow all homes and Apartment List
shelter_config.apartment_list_reason: Both shelter lines, Shelter: Rent and Shelter: Owned, use an equal blend of Zillow ZORI (all homes) and Apartment List. Apartment List measures transacted new-lease rents, which net out concessions that Zillow's asking rents do not (39.2% of Zillow rental listings offered a concession in August 2026, per Zillow), and pricing all of shelter on one index matches how the CPI Gauge prices shelter. Apartment List publishes no single-family series, so the owners' weight uses a blend that leans toward apartment rents. Zillow single-family is tracked in shadow for comparison. Apartment List publishes its Rent Estimates for public use. If that changes, Realtime moves to Zillow all-homes on both shelter lines as a logged method change.

gap_line.text: Nowflation Realtime runs below official CPI by 0.24pp: 3.16% against 3.4% for August 2026. Held at the official August 2026 subindexes with no live price, the same construction reads 3.21%, 0.19pp below CPI; that difference is construction, not market prices. Live market prices move it 0.05pp down from there: new-lease rents −0.64pp, pump prices +0.55pp and used-vehicle auction prices +0.05pp, with smaller effects from the rest.

source_months.name: Zillow ZORI, all homes (smoothed, seasonally adjusted)

parts.label: held components, whose chain shares move with the live prices

decomposition.basis: construction: Realtime's December chain with every component at its official BLS subindex, minus official CPI-U (all items, not seasonally adjusted, as BLS quotes it); live prices: Realtime minus that held build, split by each component's exact chain contribution

shelter_inputs.name: Zillow ZORI, all homes (smoothed, seasonally adjusted)

move.weights: each component's exact contribution under the December chain the headline uses: its relative importance times its price change since December, so a component whose price has moved far since December carries more than its relative importance

reconstructed_history.basis: monthly averages of the daily readings; official CPI from CPI-U all items (NSA) and shelter (NSA) year over year

vintage.statement: Live readings from 2026-09-15 are stored as published and never rewritten. Method v2.2 since 2026-09-28 (v2.0 before; readings published under v2.0 are unchanged). Values before 2026-09-15 are a reconstruction under method v2.0.
